description: Run composition, validation, rendering and code generation in one call. Use it when starting from an object/context or intent and needing generated output; use design_compose instead to inspect layout first or code_generate for an existing schema. Returns step results, schemaRef with expiry, versioned artifacts, dependencies and validationReceipt. options controls validation/render skipping and optional static accessibility checks; save persists the schema beyond its process-local 30-minute reference. Generation validation forwards draft/build/release without downgrade. Release verifies supplied evidence without rerunning it; unresolved accessibility pairs stay unmeasured. Oversized output goes to files unless options.payloadMode is inline. Calls may write composition and saved-schema records. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#pipeline_run; full schema: oods://schemas/pipeline_run.input.json.

actionMappings.description: Stage1 bridge-summary action mappings: flat, verb-keyed entries.

items.description: action Mappings item. Fields: verb, oodsTrait, trait, object, component, slot, confidence. See full schema.

intent.description: A short intent sentence, matched against fixed keyword and phrase tables (a sentence that matches no layout keyword becomes a low-confidence dashboard). Prefer object and context.

layout.description: Layout template to use. 'landing' is a content/marketing page (hero + sections + CTA), not bound to a data object. 'auto' infers the best template from intent keywords.

object.description: Object name from the OODS registry (e.g., Subscription, User).

checkA11y.description: Checks declared foreground/background pairs derived from shared component CSS against… See full schema for details.

compact.description: When true (default), omit token CSS from render output and return tokenCssRef instead. See full schema for details.

framework.description: Alias: target framework. Overridden by top-level framework if both provided.

payloadMode.description: Unset: inline up to 100,000 characters, else file. See full schema for details.

renderApply.description: Render with apply=true to include HTML output (default true).

styling.description: Alias: styling strategy. Overridden by top-level styling if both provided.

typescript.description: Alias: enable TypeScript output in code generation.

fieldGroups.description: Number of field groups for form layout.

metricColumns.description: Number of metric columns for dashboard layout.

tabCount.description: Number of tabs for detail layout.

tabLabels.description: Custom tab labels for detail layout.

profile.description: Validation profile forwarded unchanged to code.generate, including its workflow-state contract gate. build is the default blocking gate of static checks; the static gate does not install or run the generated application.

releaseEvidence.description: Hash-bound release evidence forwarded unchanged to code.generate.

accessibility.description: Structured input; read the full schema (#/$defs/releaseEvidenceItem) for its contract.

determinism.description: Structured input; read the full schema (#/$defs/releaseEvidenceItem) for its contract.

interaction.description: Structured input; read the full schema (#/$defs/releaseEvidenceItem) for its contract.

performance.description: Structured input; read the full schema (#/$defs/releaseEvidenceItem) for its contract.

rendered.description: Structured input; read the full schema (#/$defs/releaseEvidenceItem) for its contract.

theme.description: Structured input; read the full schema (#/$defs/releaseEvidenceItem) for its contract.

save.description: Optional schema save config. String for name-only, or { name, tags } for full control. Variant fields: name, tags. Read the full schema for each variant.
